members.title: fix: don't send a response for cancelled requests
members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2514: Both PRs address the same underlying spec-compliance question: what should RequestResponder.cancel() do when a request is cancelled? PR #2493 removes the incorrect error-response send and returns early (don't send any response). PR #2514 takes the fuller approach: also removes the error-response send but additionally emits a notifications/cancelled message to the remote side, per the MCP spec requirement that the cancelling party must notify. Both modify the same cancel() code path in session.py and the same server.py cancelled-request guard.
